source_organization: Instituto Nacional de Estadistica y Geografia (INEGI)

datasets.name: Directorio Estadistico Nacional de Unidades Economicas (DENUE)
Sistema de Clasificacion Industrial de America del Norte (SCIAN) 2023

aggregate_fact_used.statement: DENUE 11/2024 reports 6,058,548 establishments: 44% Comercio, 42% Servicios, 11% Industrias.
aggregate_fact_used.how_used: Only as a coarse weighting for how many synthetic vendors fall in commerce/distribution vs services vs industry. No establishment record was copied.
aggregate_fact_used.caveat: The DENUE mix describes the whole Mexican economy, not the supplier base of one manufacturer. The generator therefore tilts the mix toward services and industrial supply, which is what a manufacturer actually buys. The DENUE figure anchors the ordering, not the exact proportions.

geography_note: Municipality and state names are real Mexican places (geography is not an identifiable business). Street numbers, interior numbers and the businesses themselves are synthetic.
